big_case.notes: Two real doctrinal questions (legislative immunity against official-capacity prospective relief; whether enforcing a viewpoint-based public-comment rule is a legislative act) on a culturally salient speech subject, with four cert-stage amicus briefs from advocacy groups. But the dispute is confined to state legislative committee procedure, the judgment below was unanimous with en banc review denied without a poll, no governmental or institutional amici appeared, and the Court denied without a noted dissent or statement.
